newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain says two priests held in Zaire mission.
newsitem.headline: Spain says two priests held in Zaire mission.

text.p: Two European priests are being held after their mission was seized in a Tutsi attack on the eastern Zairean city of Bukavu, the Spanish Foreign Office said on Wednesday.
"This morning, a band apparently made up of Tutsis took the Carmelite San Juan de Dios mission in Bukavu," a spokeswoman for the ministry said.

All the priests had managed to flee the mission except for Spanish priest Jesus Gutierrez Portero and a Belgian priest who was not identified, she added. Spanish ambassador to Zaire Jose Antonio Bordallo was negotiating the men's release.
Roman Catholic archbishop Christophe Munzihirwa Mwene Ngabo was killed earlier on Wednesday, apparently during an ambush.
Bukavu, the capital of Zaire's South Kivu province, has been under attack from ethnic Tutsi Banyamulenge rebels and Zairean troops have been on a looting spree in recent days.
It was not clear which of the two groups controlled Bukavu on Wednesday evening.
